known_facts: A September 2010 presentation projected that 34th Street Transitway service would begin in Summer 2012.

Primary assessment: The 2010 diagram projects a Summer 2012 start for the proposed 34th Street Transitway. It does not establish delivery and cannot be collapsed into the materially different M34/M34A fare-prepayment service.
prohibited_inferences: Do not alias the abandoned transitway design to the later M34/M34A SBS treatment onset.
Do not infer implementation from the project schedule.
Do not publish an exact route × treatment occurrence from this frozen evidence.
Do not substitute later 34th Street SBS or bus-lane observations for the proposed transitway.
